newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heineken no comment on El Aguila bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Heineken no comment on El Aguila bid talk.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken said on Thursday it would not comment on Madrid market talk that it was considering bidding for the 35.2 percent of Spanish brewer El Aguila that it does not already own.
"Those are stock exchange rumours and we never comment on rumours," a Heineken spokeswoman said.
"These rumours resurface every six months. They have no foundation," an El Aguila executive said.
Shares in El Aguila have soared in the last few days. On Wednesday, the shares added over 10 percent, jumping from 616 pesetas to close at 680.
On Thursday, the shares traded up to 722 pesetas before settling at 692 with volume of 214,000, 10 times the average daily volume.

Heineken currently owns 64.8 percent of El Aguila, which has been plagued with losses in recent years. In the full year 1995, the company made a pretax loss of 2.03 billion pesetas on revenues of 49.8 billion. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
